note: Crittenden County's only public parcel source is the Schneider qPublic PVA viewer (qpublic.net/ky/crittenden), which returns HTTP 403 Access Denied / bot-check to automated access, so no queryable parcel service was found. The state kygisserver WGS84WM_Services folder has PVA parcel services only for Webster County (Ky_PVA_Webster_Parcels_WGS84WM), none for Crittenden. The KYTC PVA availability layer lists CRITTENDEN as 'Without Ownership'. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online returned no Crittenden parcel service; the remaining Crittenden parcel sources are commercial (Regrid, DynamoSpatial, Acres, AcreValue, Rockford Map, Equator).
